an4.6:1.1: cattāro’me bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.6:1.7: kathañca bhikkhave, puggalo appassuto hoti sutena anupapanno?
an4.6:1.8: idha bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa appakaṃ sutaṃ hoti
an4.6:1.9: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.6:1.10: so tassa appakassa sutassa na atthamaññāya na dhammamaññāya na dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.6:1.11: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, puggalo appassuto hoti sutena anupapanno.
an4.6:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave, puggalo appassuto hoti sutena upapanno?
an4.6:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa appakaṃ sutaṃ hoti
an4.6:2.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.6:2.4: so tassa appakassa sutassa atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.6:2.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, puggalo appassuto hoti, sutena upapanno.
an4.6:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave, puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena anupapanno?
an4.6:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa bahuṃ sutaṃ hoti
an4.6:3.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.6:3.4: so tassa bahukassa sutassa na atthamaññāya na dhammamaññāya na dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.6:3.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena anupapanno.
an4.6:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave, puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena upapanno?
an4.6:4.2: idha bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa bahuṃ sutaṃ hoti
an4.6:4.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.6:4.4: so tassa bahukassa sutassa atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.6:4.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena upapanno.
an4.6:4.6: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
